name: player_auto_switch_to_next_usable_alt_weapon
description: Player::AutoSwitchToNextUsableAltWeapon selects the nearest usable alt weapon controller with ammo when the current alt weapon cannot continue.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player weapon/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43c660 validates the fastcall save-state ABI, activeAltGunController bank-zero early return, same-bank opposite-side probe, lower-bank scan from current-1 down through bank 2, upper-bank scan from current+1 through bank 9, ctrlA-before-ctrlB order in cross-bank scans, enabled flag 0x04 gate, IsAltWeaponAllowedInCurrentMasterMode call, strict positive-ammo gate, and HandleAltWeaponBankSelectInput(bank+14) dispatch.
The native smoke verifies same-bank opposite-side selection, lower-bank selection, and upper-bank selection through the real HandleAltWeaponBankSelectInput handoff.
